dct_description_sm: These datasets were collected to estimate the accumulation and ablation along a 50 km transect from the ice cap summit to its southern margin and to develop a method of downscaling coarse resolution global climate model temperature output over glacier surfaces.  The sensor transect was located on the south slope of the Devon Island Ice Cap.  An additional dataset of centerline near-surface air temperatures and valley wall meteorological station measurements was also collected over the Belcher Glacier, a major outlet glacier of the Devon Island Ice Cap, to estimate glacier melt.
dct_title_s: Glaciodyn (Canada) IPY Project: Weather station and temperature sensor data collected over the Devon Island Ice Cap
